title: I Can Start Today
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
A wise man wrote a word for me
When I was very small:
Remember Heavenly Father now —
Today's the best of all.

[Chorus]
I do not have to wait to grow,
I can begin today;
My heart is soft and ready now
To love Him all the way.

[Verse 2]
My heart is like the springtime ground
Where little seeds are sown;
So plant His love inside me deep
And watch how tall it's grown.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Each prayer I say, each tale I hear,
Each kindness that I do,
Will help me know Him better now
And all my whole life through.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
So close your eyes, my little one,
The seed is in your heart;
You never were too small to love —
Tonight is where you start.

[Chorus]
mood: Beginning music. A small, simple figure opens it alone — only a few notes, the size of a child's own first try — and one more strand joins quietly underneath each verse, the way a seed puts out a root and then a leaf. Fingerpicked guitar, unhurried, with a low sustained warmth that arrives late and then stays. It grows without ever getting louder, so the last verse feels planted rather than finished.
